wages.text: Jeffries introduced the PRO Act to strengthen workers' right to organize and has long backed raising the minimum wage.
wages.quote: I have worked with my House colleagues to introduce the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, landmark legislation that will protect the essential right of workers to organize for better working conditions

debt.text: Jeffries vows to defend Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid from cuts.
debt.quote: Not now, not ever, will we let you touch Social Security, Medicare or Medicaid.

housing.text: Jeffries says he is working to build and preserve affordable apartments and homes and to expand public housing units.
housing.quote: fighting hard to build and protect apartments and homes in our neighborhoods that existing residents can actually afford.

immigration.text: Jeffries calls for immigration reform that creates a pathway to citizenship for undocumented immigrants and protects Dreamers.
immigration.quote: We must reform our broken immigration system and create a pathway toward citizenship for the millions of undocumented hardworking individuals who dream of becoming Americans.

guns.text: Jeffries pushes for universal background checks and a ban on assault weapons.
guns.quote: universal background checks for firearm purchases and a ban on assault weapons that belong in war zones, not in our streets

abortion.text: Jeffries says decisions about pregnancy should rest with women, their families and doctors, not politicians.
abortion.quote: He believes women, their families and their doctors should make these deeply personal decisions about pregnancy, not extreme Republican politicians.

cannabis.text: Jeffries backs the MORE Act to end federal cannabis prohibition and decriminalize marijuana.
cannabis.quote: we must pass the MORE Act, decriminalize marijuana in America and bring to life the principle of liberty and justice for all.

health.text: Jeffries supports strengthening and expanding the Affordable Care Act and protecting Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: I will continue to work with my fellow Democrats to strengthen and grow the Affordable Care Act while refusing to allow extremists to repeal it.

energy.text: Jeffries calls for urgent action on the climate crisis and touts the Inflation Reduction Act's clean-energy investments.
energy.quote: The cost of the climate crisis is undeniable for families and must be addressed with the fierce urgency of now.

voting.text: Jeffries defends mail-in voting and pushes the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act against what he calls voter suppression.
voting.quote: They continue to peddle baseless conspiracy theories about our elections, attack mail-in voting and redraw congressional maps to decimate Black representation.
